## The system

Which system do the records come from, or which system do the arguments go to? Name the platform
as the gateway's catalog does, if it is there.

## The pack

The pack's id, and the versions or digests the dialect would be written against.

## Direction

`input`, `output` or `both`.

## Source kinds

The kinds the dialect's sources would use, from RFC 0018's list.

## Fixtures' origin

Where the recorded records for the fixtures would come from (recorded from a real system, or
synthetic), and who has the right to publish them.

## Personal data removed

How personal data, credentials and tokens are kept out of the fixtures and the README.

## Licence

The SPDX identifier the entry would carry.
